_comment: Per-FACTION harbor-town identities (Factions module). data/town-layout.mjs assigns each detected pier site a faction (spatial spheres) FIRST, then draws its name+description from the owning nation's pool (seeded shuffle per faction). Pools cycle with a numeral suffix if a faction ever holds more towns than names. 1700s Caribbean theme — English / French / Spanish / Dutch. Edit/extend freely; ~15 per faction comfortably covers a ~50-town map (~12-13 per faction).
